OmniTune 1.5.3 is a stable reliability and library-management update.

## Highlights

- Improved search reliability for incomplete and unsupported YouTube Music results.
- Added verified YouTube Music sign-in, plus selectable imports for playlists in your account.
- Added Backup & Restore in Settings for your OmniTune library, with optional offline-download archives.
- Improved restored-queue playback, next-track handling, playlist creation feedback, and playback responsiveness.
